lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking where the gray mist meets the land,
Holding ghosts of time within my hand,
A single spark against the heavy night,
Chasing shadows toward a fading light.
[Chorus]
Mountains rise to touch the frozen sky,
Where the golden eagles learn to fly,
Every heartbeat is a drum of gold,
In the stories that the ages told.
[Verse]
The river carves a path through ancient stone,
I walk the winding road, but not alone,
With every breath, the spirit starts to rise,
Beneath the gaze of vast and watchful eyes.
[Chorus]
Mountains rise to touch the frozen sky,
Where the golden eagles learn to fly,
Every heartbeat is a drum of gold,
In the stories that the ages told.
[Bridge]
The wild horizon calls my name out loud,
Above the valley and the swirling cloud.
[Chorus]
Mountains rise to touch the frozen sky,
Where the golden eagles learn to fly,
Every heartbeat is a drum of gold,
In the stories that the ages told.
[Outro]
